releaseNotes: New Overview dashboard with one-click Quick Clean for each area (choose what each includes via its gear button). The background agent no longer has a separate switch - it runs automatically when browser monitoring or the low-disk-space monitor is enabled. The low-disk-space monitor now cleans a set of categories you choose and its threshold can be set in MB or GB. Optional 'wake the computer' for scheduled cleanups. Fixes: Quick Access pinned links are no longer removed by cleanup, plus reliability fixes to secure delete accounting and saved cleanup statistics.
